<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <meta name="description" content="">
  <title>Untitled</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; scroll-behavior: smooth; }
    :target { scroll-margin-block: 1rem; }
    body {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video, canvas, picture { max-width: 100%; display: block; }
    img, video { height: auto; }
    pre, code, kbd, samp { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.9em; }
    pre { overflow-x: auto; tab-size: 2; }
    table { border-collapse: collapse; }
    th, td { padding: 0.25em 0.5em; text-align: start; vertical-align: top; }
    sub, sup { line-height: 0; }
    a { text-underline-offset: 0.15em; }
    button:not(:disabled), [role="button"], summary, label[for] { cursor: pointer; }
    textarea { resize: vertical; }
    [hidden] { display: none !important; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>
  </main>
</body>
</html>

content.text:
I read `0.html`. It's an empty starter template, and the CSS base is already solid: box-sizing, fluid media, readable line length, system fonts, dark mode support, focus styles and reduced-motion handling. There isn't much to fix without knowing what the page is for.

There are a few small issues I could fix:

- **Empty `<meta name="description" content="">`**: an empty description is worse than none. It should be filled in or removed.
- **`<title>Untitled</title>`**: this is a placeholder that needs a real title.
- **`img { display: block }`**: this breaks images meant to sit inline with text, like icons or emoji images. `vertical-align: middle` is a safer default.
- **`sub, sup { line-height: 0 }`**: the usual fix also sets `position: relative` and `vertical-align` offsets so superscripts don't push lines apart.
- **Empty `<main>`**: there's no content yet, and no `<header>` or `<footer>` structure.

What do you want "improve" to mean?

1. **Polish the template**: apply the fixes above and keep it a blank starter.
2. **Build it out**: tell me what the page is for, such as a landing page, docs, a portfolio or a tool, and I'll write the content and styling.
3. **Visual design**: add colours, typography and layout on top of the current base.
